amortization.note: Contract template Ver05.2026 (effective 22/05/2026), Điều 1.8: one monthly instalment amount, with the last instalment allowed to differ "do lãi được tính trên dư nợ gốc giảm dần" (interest on the declining balance) = equal instalments. Confirmed by the page's own calculator: 40,000,000 VND over 24 months shows 2.350.077 VND a month, which is exactly an equal-instalment (annuity) loan at 35,44181% a year reducing (the calculator's embedded interestRate 0.3544181). The earlier inference of equal principal came from the 0,75%/month marketing illustration only; see conflicts.

representativeExamples.note: Page example (illustrative, 'khoảng' amounts, shown at the best rate): first instalment ~1,817,000 VND (principal 1,667,000 + interest 150,000), last ~1,679,000, total interest ~975,000. monthlyPaymentVnd is the FIRST instalment only; instalments fall each month. Arithmetic checks out: interest = 20,000,000 x 0.75% x 13 / 2 = 975,000, total 20,975,000. The 0.75%/month rate is about one-fifth of the official new-customer rate (45-55%/year), so treat as a marketing example, not a fixture.

Product-page FAQ (also /faq/vay-tien-mat): "vay 60 triệu, 12 tháng, lãi suất phẳng 20,22%/năm. Số tiền góp mỗi tháng 5.997.779đ; tổng 71.973.348đ" (excludes optional insurance, transfer fee and early-repayment fee). 5.997.779 x 12 = 71.973.348 is correct, but 20,22% flat for 12 months would give 72.132.000 (the page's own calculator note says exactly that). 5.997.779 is exactly an equal-instalment loan at 35,00%/year reducing (flat 19,96% over 12 months; 20,22% flat equals 35% reducing only over 24 months). So the printed flat label does not reproduce the payment. Do not use as a fixture.

Output of the product page's own loan calculator, read in a browser 2026-11-03 with the default inputs (40.000.000 VND, 24 tháng): 'Tiền góp hàng tháng 2.350.077 VNĐ'. 2.350.077 is exactly an equal-instalment loan at 35,44181%/year reducing, matching interestRate 0.3544181 in the page data (our recomputation, so the rate is inferred, not stated). The calculator note prints 'lãi suất phẳng 20.22%/năm', which for 24 months would give 2.340.667, so the label and the output differ. Calculator excludes fees. This 35,44% sits below the new-customer minimum (45%) on the rate sheet.

Google Play listing example: 40.000.000 VND, 12 tháng, 'lãi suất phẳng 8,99%/năm (dựa theo chính sách của mỗi sản phẩm vay)', monthly 3.651.000 VND including 'phí thu hộ 11.000 VND/tháng', total 43.812.000, total interest 3.812.000. 3.651.000 x 12 = 43.812.000 is correct, but 8,99% flat gives 3.633.000 + 11.000 = 3.644.000 a month (43.728.000 total); 7.000 a month (84.000 in total) is unexplained. 8,99% flat equals about 16,2% reducing, the existing-customer minimum. This is the best-rate case, not a typical one. Do not use as a fixture.

products.notes: Cash-loan rates come from the official rate sheet effective 21/07/2026 (scanned image, re-read 2026-11-03). The product page's own advertised figures (0,75%/month, flat 8,99%-33,94%/year, calculator 35,44% reducing, FAQ example 35% reducing) all describe the cheap end and existing customers; the sheet says new customers pay 45%-55%/year reducing. Equal-instalment repayment (annuity) per the contract template. Interest is charged daily on the actual balance (balance x annual rate / 365). An 11,000 VND fee per instalment is charged on top. Optional insurance is financed inside the loan. Late fee amounts, overdue-interest rate and early-repayment % are not published.

borrowerNotes.vi: Quảng cáo ghi từ 0,75%/tháng, nhưng biểu lãi suất của Home Credit ghi 45–55%/năm cho khách hàng mới. Biểu này cũng ghi chỉ áp dụng tại một số điểm dịch vụ. Hãy hỏi mức của bạn trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: Ads say from 0.75% a month, but Home Credit's rate sheet says 45–55% a year for new customers. The sheet also says it applies only at some service points. Ask for your rate before signing.

researchNotes:
LICENSING: Home Credit is on data/licensed-institutions.json (licence 90/GP-NHNN). Legal name on the contracts: Công ty Tài chính TNHH Một thành viên Home Credit Việt Nam, MST 0307672788, Ho Chi Minh City. No rename found. Secondary news only (not verified at an official source, does not affect the licence): a reported sale of the Vietnam unit to SCBX of Thailand was said to have been cancelled around March 2026.
OFFICIAL DOCUMENT INDEX (found 2026-11-03): https://www.homecredit.vn/mau-hop-dong lists every rate sheet and contract template by product, with effective dates. Cash loan: rate sheet 21/07/2026, contract 22/05/2026. Motorbike: rate sheet (document says 01/07/2024, index says 06/02/2025), contract 22/05/2026. Electronics: rate sheet 06/02/2025, contract 22/05/2026. 'Ngành hàng mới' sheet 01/07/2024. Home PayLater rate sheet dated 01/03/2023: 0%-45%/year reducing (not added: revolving product, 3 years old, no fee data). Gói An tâm Tài chính has its own loan contract (Ver 07.2024) that is no longer on the index; the Ver05.2026 contracts now finance the premium inside the main loan. Pre-signing notice 30/06/2026 lists rights and collection steps (no rates).
CASH LOAN RATE (main finding): the rate sheet effective 21/07/2026 was re-read and every row confirmed: new customers 45%-55%/year reducing; existing customers 16,22%-49,50%/year; insurance-premium loan 16,22%-55%/year. The product page, calculator, FAQ example and Google Play listing all show cheaper figures: '0,75%/tháng', 'lãi suất phẳng 8,99%-33,94%/năm', a calculator at 35,44% reducing (labelled flat 20,22%), an FAQ example at exactly 35% reducing. By our arithmetic 8,99% flat over 12 months = 16,2% reducing, and 33,94% flat over 57 months = 49,5% reducing, so the advertised flat range is the existing-customer row; nothing advertised matches the 45%-55% that new customers get per the sheet. Footnote (**) on the sheet says the product is only at some service points, yet the product page links this sheet for its own rates.
THE '19.92%' LEAD: no official Home Credit page, PDF, app listing or contract found contains 19,92%. Searched homecredit.vn product pages, FAQs, blog, rate sheets, Google Play and the App Store listing text. Related official figures: 20,22% flat (FAQ example and calculator note), 19,96% (flat 12-month equivalent of 35% reducing, our arithmetic), 8,99% and 33,94% flat. A flat 19,92% over 12 months equals about 34,9% reducing, so the lead probably restates the 35% reducing example. Treat as unverified and unusable.
INSTALMENT PRODUCTS: the rate disclosure exists but is old. Motorbike and electronics sheets both show 0%-49,50%/year reducing (daily balance x rate / 365). The pages' own calculators use constant rates (read from page data and reproduced to the dong in the browser): motorbike 37% and electronics 45% reducing, equal instalments. All three product pages' calculators are consistent with a rate sheet range, but the sheets are 16-21 months old, so ranges are low confidence. The homepage 'phẳng từ 0,55%/tháng' is a marketing floor inside the range.
FEES: the sheets list only 'Phí chuyển tiền' 11.000 đ and 'Phí trả nợ trước thời hạn' (per contract). The Google Play listing shows 11.000 VND a month inside the instalment ('phí thu hộ'), now modelled as a mandatory monthly fee on the cash loan (medium; conservative). Early repayment: free for 3-10 triệu cash loans (page); motorbike FAQ: free at 0%, otherwise 5% of the loan (base unclear). Cash-loan early-repayment % is blank in the contract. Application is free (FAQ).
INSURANCE: Gói An tâm Tài chính is optional on all loans (FAQ; page headline calls insurance 'không bắt buộc'; blog says voluntary). Premium not published anywhere: searched product page, /bao-hiem/goi-an-tam-tai-chinh, /faq/bao-hiem, /faq/vay-tien-mat, blog, both credit contracts (premium fields blank). Premium is financed inside the loan principal per the Ver05.2026 contracts and earns interest. Optional motorbike insurance 319.000 / 379.000 / 629.000 VND a year by vehicle value (GIC). Optional screen and device insurances exist (102.000-239.000 and 149.000-5.779.000 VND).
AMOUNT: cash loan page says up to 250M VND, above the 100M finance-company cap (Circular 43/2016 art. 3(1)); recorded as a conflict for a lawyer. Motorbike max 100M, electronics max 40M.
GAPS: late-fee amounts, overdue-interest %, cash-loan early-repayment %, Gói An tâm premium, whether the 11,000 VND per-instalment fee is charged on every loan and channel, motorbike and electronics rate sheets newer than 2025, minimum income, credit card figures (tariff PDF listed 04/09/2026 at https://www.homecredit.vn/upload/260904_Credit_card_Tariff_stamp_85ee417aeb.pdf, not read), Home PayLater, Big Ticket and entrusted-loan contracts not collected. Cash-loan contract pages 5-8 not read; motorbike contract pages 2-7 read, electronics page 2 read.
RANKING: cash loan, motorbike and electronics are now ranked (offered_range with stated basis). Motorbike and electronics are low confidence because their sheets are over a year old, and their 0% minimum is a selected-goods promotion, so the low-cost end of their cost range should not drive the ranking.
